title: OpenXLR skin
description: A skin for the OpenXLR window. docs/skins.md is the contract; this file is a writing aid for editors that complete and check JSON.

$schema.description: Ignored by OpenXLR; it points an editor at this file.

schema.description: The skin format version this file is written for.

id.description: The id the author intended. The folder name wins when they disagree.

description.description: One line, shown under the picker.

controls.description: One of OpenXLR's own appearances per control.

tokens.description: The appearance values. A token OpenXLR does not have is reported and ignored.

Ox.Card.Background.description: a section card: INPUTS, HEADPHONES, an Options group

Ox.Tile.Background.description: a tile on a card: a channel strip, a mix master, an application chip

Ox.Dialog.Background.description: the small dialogs: confirmations, rename and the input binding dialog

Ox.Text.Info.description: informational lines: an available update, and the hardware badge's lettering in the EQ editor and the Ducking window

Ox.Text.Detail.description: paragraphs in About, release notes, plugin group headings

Ox.Badge.Background.description: a small badge: the format badge beside a plugin name, a strip's binding or capture source chip, and the hardware badge in the EQ editor and the Ducking window

Ox.Divider.description: the rule under a plugin control group

Ox.Strip.FontWeight.description: the name over a channel strip or a mix

Ox.Font.Family.description: the font the buttons, labels and dropdowns use

Ox.Led.On.description: a connected device, a plugin that is processing, the button of a chain with one, a microphone's **EQ** button while its EQ runs, a matrix row's **Mic** button while one of its switches is on

Ox.Led.Off.description: a device that is not there

Ox.Led.Alert.description: a plugin bypassed or failed, the button of a chain with nothing processing, a microphone's **EQ** button while its EQ cannot run, the phantom power lamp on a matrix row's **Mic** button while phantom power is on

Ox.Meter.Fill.description: the quiet end of the scale

Ox.Meter.Hot.description: the loud end of the scale

Ox.Meter.HotLevel.description: -6 dBFS, where an RMS reading leaves no headroom for the peaks

Ox.Meter.Track.description: the groove a meter sits in, and an unlit cell

Ox.Meter.CornerRadius.description: the meter's corners, and each cell's

Ox.Meter.VerticalWidth.description: how thick an upright meter is, where a strip template stands its meter up; it is as long as what it stands beside

Ox.Meter.SegmentGap.description: the gap between cells in pixels, `meter: segmented` only

Ox.Led.Size.description: the box a lamp or a dot is drawn in, both appearances

Ox.Led.Bezel.description: the ring around the core, `led: lamp` only

Ox.Led.Glow.description: the halo while the lamp is lit, 0 for none, `led: lamp` only

Ox.Led.CoreScale.description: how much of the box the lit core fills, `led: lamp` only

Ox.Fader.Track.description: the part of the groove above the value

Ox.Fader.Thumb.Grip.description: the line across the cap, `fader: console` only

Ox.Fader.Thumb.GripLength.description: how long that line is, `fader: console` only

Ox.Control.Background.description: a button, a toggle, a dropdown

Ox.Control.Foreground.description: the lettering on a button or a dropdown

Ox.Control.ForegroundChecked.description: a toggle's lettering when on, unless `Ox.Toggle.ForegroundChecked` is set

Ox.Control.ForegroundDisabled.description: the lettering when the control cannot be used

Ox.Ghost.Background.description: the face behind a button a view keeps out of the way: the header actions, the rows inside a flyout

Ox.Cap.Bevel.description: the gloss over every raised key face, `button: cap` and `mute: cap` only; usually a gradient, and one brush for all of them so the keys cannot drift apart

Ox.Toggle.ForegroundDisabled.description: a toggle that cannot be used

Ox.Toggle.BorderBrushChecked.description: the ring of a toggle that is on

Ox.Bypass.Foreground.description: the plugin bypass key while the plugin is processing

Ox.Bypass.ForegroundBypassed.description: the same key while the plugin is bypassed

Ox.Check.Foreground.description: the label beside a checkbox, which is running text rather than a lit legend

Ox.Control.CornerRadius.description: the corners of every key, and of the boxes the framework rounds

Ox.Control.BorderThickness.description: the ring's width on a raised key, `button: cap` and `mute: cap` only

Ox.Control.DisabledOpacity.description: how far a key fades when it cannot be used, 1 for no fade

Ox.Control.BorderBrushDisabled.description: the ring when the control cannot be used

Ox.Flyout.Background.description: a dropdown's list and a flyout

Ox.Accent.description: the tick in a checkbox and the selection in a list; must be flat, since the theme reads it as a colour

Ox.AppIcon.Size.description: the square an application's icon is drawn in

Ox.AppIcon.Background.description: the badge drawn instead of an icon the desktop does not have

Ox.AppIcon.Foreground.description: the application's initial on that badge

Ox.AppColumns.NameWidth.description: the width of an application's name in a tile of APPLICATIONS' columns, the same in every tile; a longer name is clipped and scrolls to its end while the pointer is over its tile

Ox.Flow.CardSelected.description: the node whose path is being traced

Ox.Flow.Text.description: a node's name and the window's title

Ox.Flow.TextDim.description: a node's second line, the legend and the selected node's outline

Ox.Flow.Input.description: an edge from an input to a channel

Ox.Flow.Channel.description: an edge from a channel to a mix

Ox.Flow.Output.description: an edge from a mix to an output

Ox.Flow.Muted.description: an edge that is muted or not in the traced path

Ox.Eq.Background.description: the EQ graph's ground, and the number on a band's handle

Ox.Eq.Grid.description: the graph's lines every 6 dB and at the region edges, and the readout's outline

Ox.Eq.GridLabel.description: the axis labels, the readout and the 0 dB line

Ox.Eq.ZoneA.description: the first, third and fifth regions, over the ground

Ox.Eq.ZoneB.description: the second, fourth and sixth regions, over the ground

Ox.Eq.ZoneLabel.description: the regions' names along the top

Ox.Eq.Curve.description: the sum of the four bands while the EQ is on

Ox.Eq.CurveFill.description: the fill between that sum and 0 dB

Ox.Eq.Band1.description: band 1: its handle, its own curve and its number in the rows

Ox.Eq.HandleOff.description: the number on the handle of a band that is off, and the sum while the EQ is off or compared

Ox.Eq.HandleRing.description: the ring around the selected band's handle

Ox.Eq.CurveThickness.description: the width of the sum's line

Ox.Eq.BandCurveThickness.description: the width of each band's own curve

Ox.Eq.HandleSize.description: the diameter of a band's handle; the pointer takes it within 20 units of its centre, or the compact control minimum under Touch sizing

Ox.Eq.LabelFontSize.description: the size of the axis labels, the region names and the readout, and of the hardware badge's text in the EQ editor and the Ducking window

Ox.Eq.CornerRadius.description: the graph's corners, and the hardware badge's in the EQ editor and the Ducking window

Ox.Mixer.ControlMinSize.description: the smallest width and height of a mixer button, dropdown, check box, text box, slider and fader cap

Ox.Mixer.SliderMinHeight.description: the smallest height of a mixer slider

Ox.Mixer.DeviceSliderHeight.description: the height of a slider in the interface's control rows

Ox.Mixer.SmallControlMinSize.description: the smallest size of the compact controls: the interface rows' buttons and sliders, the tile headers and their buttons, the Arrange buttons and drag handles, the gain lock, the binding and capture source chips, the inserts buttons, the SUBMIXER header's buttons, a send's mute and the EQ graph's handle target

Ox.Mixer.InsertControlMinSize.description: the smallest width and height of an insert row's own process, bypass and controls buttons

Ox.Mixer.ChannelWidth.description: the width of a submixer channel strip

Ox.Mixer.MixWidth.description: the width of a mix master tile

Ox.Mixer.StripWidth.description: the width of an upright strip in a mix bank, the name column of a send list, and the unit an input rack and mix banks reckon their narrowest width in

Ox.Mixer.VerticalFaderLength.description: the length of an upright fader

Ox.Mixer.HiddenOpacity.description: how far a channel or mix hidden in the layout editor fades while the submixer's Show hidden draws it, 1 for no fade

Ox.Matrix.NameWidth.description: the width of a row head's name column, which holds the name, the binding line under it, the **Mic** button and the gain under it

Ox.Matrix.CellWidth.description: the width of a cell, of a column head and of a row head's source controls

Ox.Matrix.RowHeight.description: the height of a row: its head and every cell in it; a row whose head stacks a gain over the channel volume, or the **EQ** button over the chain's, is as tall as the two need, never less

Ox.Matrix.MutedBackground.description: the background of a cell whose send is muted, when the matrix tints muted cells. Translucent by default, so the cell's own surface shows through as a red tint

Ox.Matrix.MutedForeground.description: the lettering of a muted send's mute in a tinted cell

Ox.Matrix.MutedOpacity.description: how far a muted send's fader and level fade when the matrix dims muted cells; the mute keeps its own colour

layout.description: Where the header and the main window's sections go. Taken whole or not at all.

icons.description: The skin's own channel and mix icons, name to SVG path data. Only the window draws them.

path.description: SVG path data in a 24 by 24 box, filled under the nonzero rule.

from.description: The near end of a linear gradient, or a radial's highlight.

to.description: The far end of a linear gradient, or a radial's centre.

radius.description: A radial gradient's radius, relative to the box.

source.description: A relative path inside the skin's own folder.

flatColour.description: An indicator colour, which is drawn in code and must stay flat.

radius.description: One number, or four: top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left.

thickness.description: One number, two, or four: left, top, right, bottom.

fontFamily.description: A font family the machine already has.

desktopLayout.description: The skin's desktop layout. It has its own version, separate from the file's schema.

version.description: The layout format this block is written for.

main.description: The window's tree. Without it the sections keep the classic arrangement.

layoutNode.description: A node of the tree, chosen by its kind: a container or a region.

layoutContainer.description: A container: a stack, a grid or a dock. main is one.

layoutId.description: The container's id, unique in the tree. Your own arrangement names its places by it.

layoutSpacing.description: The gap between children in pixels.

layoutStack.description: Children one after another, in one direction.

orientation.description: vertical is one above the other, the classic window; horizontal is one row.

children.description: Regions and containers in the order they appear.

layoutTrack.description: A grid row or column: auto, a star share, or a fixed size.

oneOf.description: As large as what it holds.

star.description: A share of what the other tracks leave.

size.description: A fixed size in pixels, raised to what the track holds.

layoutGrid.description: Children in cells of rows and columns.

rowSpan.description: How many rows it covers, never past the last.

columnSpan.description: How many columns it covers, never past the last.

children.description: Regions and containers, each in its cell. Two children never cover the same cell.

layoutDock.description: Children against its edges in order; the last one fills what is left.

dock.description: The edge it sits against. Exactly one child fills, and it is the last.

children.description: Regions and containers, each against its edge.

layoutRegion.description: One part of the window the application builds.

region.description: Which part goes here. Each section once, the header at most once.

layoutRegions.description: Options for the header and the sections, by region id.

layoutSectionOptions.description: What a skin says about one section beyond where it goes.

visibility.description: collapsed folds the section the first time the skin is worn; hidden leaves it out until it is shown from Arrange mode.

width.description: A preferred width in pixels, where the section has a width of its own.

height.description: A preferred height in pixels, the least the section takes.

layoutInputsOptions.description: INPUTS: the options every section has, and the template it is drawn with.

visibility.description: collapsed folds the section the first time the skin is worn; hidden leaves it out until it is shown from Arrange mode.

width.description: A preferred width in pixels, where the section has a width of its own.

height.description: A preferred height in pixels, the least the section takes.

template.description: hardware-panel is the INPUTS panel; input-rack draws one strip per input channel.

strip.description: How an input rack's strips are drawn. Only with template input-rack.

layoutSubmixerOptions.description: The submixer: the options every section has, the template it is drawn with, for mix banks how many show and how they are drawn, and for a mix matrix how its heads and cells are drawn.

visibility.description: collapsed folds the section the first time the skin is worn; hidden leaves it out until it is shown from Arrange mode.

width.description: A preferred width in pixels, where the section has a width of its own.

height.description: A preferred height in pixels, the least the section takes.

template.description: channel-tiles is the classic submixer; mix-banks draws banks by mix, each with a picker of every mix; mix-matrix draws a row per channel and a column per mix, with each send where they cross.

orientation.description: The way the banks follow one another. Only with template mix-banks.

visibleBanks.description: How many banks show, never more than there are mixes. Only with template mix-banks.

selectionDefaults.description: Mix ids the banks start on until the user picks; an id with no mix is skipped. Only with template mix-banks.

strip.description: How a bank's strips are drawn. Only with template mix-banks.

master.description: How a bank's master is drawn. Only with template mix-banks.

matrix.description: How the matrix's row heads, column heads and cells are drawn. Only with template mix-matrix.

popOut.description: Where the submixer starts out, with any template.

partsOrder.description: The input row's parts in the order the strip draws them. Parts left out follow in their default order; a part appears once across partsOrder and hidden.

hidden.description: Parts the strip leaves out. identity is always shown.

layoutBankStrip.description: A mix bank's strip: one channel's send into the bank's mix.

template.description: vertical-strip stacks a send's parts in a column, the strips side by side; send-list puts them in a row, the rows one above the other.

partsOrder.description: The send strip's parts in the order the strip draws them. Parts left out follow in their default order; a part appears once across partsOrder and hidden.

hidden.description: Parts the strip leaves out. identity is always shown.

template.description: master-card is the mix tile under the strips; master-strip is one more strip at their end.

layoutMatrix.description: A mix matrix: how its row heads, column heads and cells are drawn, and where the channel's meter goes.

meter.description: under-fader draws the channel's meter as the track of every fader in its row; none leaves plain faders.

layoutMatrixRowHead.description: A matrix row head: a channel's name and the controls the INPUTS panel shows for it.

parts.description: Parts in the order they are drawn. Parts left out follow in their default order; a part appears once across parts and hidden.

hidden.description: Parts left out. identity is always shown.

layoutMatrixColumnHead.description: A matrix column head: a mix's name, its outputs line, its master, mute and chain button.

parts.description: Parts in the order they are drawn. Parts left out follow in their default order; a part appears once across parts and hidden.

hidden.description: Parts left out. identity is always shown.

layoutMatrixCell.description: A matrix cell: one channel's send into one mix.

parts.description: Parts in the order they are drawn. Parts left out follow in their default order; a part appears once across parts and hidden.

hidden.description: Parts left out. fader is always shown.

muted.description: tint colours a muted send's cell with Ox.Matrix.MutedBackground; dim fades its fader and level to Ox.Matrix.MutedOpacity.

valuePlacement.description: Where the value part draws the send's level: beside the fader in its part order, or at the top centre of the cell only while the fader is being moved.

layoutLabel.description: How a strip names its channel or mix.

style.description: icon shows the icon alone where there is one; a screen reader still hears the whole name.

layoutMeter.description: A strip's meter. It is always the channel's or the mix's own level.

orientation.description: Flat or upright. Upright by default in a vertical strip or a master strip.

placement.description: below-label is a part of its own; beside-label and beside-fader stand it beside that part. beside-fader by default in a vertical strip or a master strip.

orientation.description: Flat or upright. Upright by default in a vertical strip or a master strip.

direction.description: reversed puts the maximum at the bottom or at the left.

layoutHeaderOptions.description: The header's action order and overflow menu. Options is always first and always shown.

actions.description: Actions in the order the header shows them.

overflow.description: Actions in the menu at the end of the header. An action appears once across both lists.

layoutMonitorOptions.description: MONITOR: the options every section has, and the template it is drawn with.

visibility.description: collapsed folds the section the first time the skin is worn; hidden leaves it out until it is shown from Arrange mode.

width.description: A preferred width in pixels, where the section has a width of its own.

height.description: A preferred height in pixels, the least the section takes.

template.description: output-panel is the MONITOR panel; output-toolbar is one compact row with the output picker, the volume and its readout, in two rows below 560 pixels.

layoutApplicationsOptions.description: APPLICATIONS: the options every section has, the template it is drawn with, and how many applications a column holds.

visibility.description: collapsed folds the section the first time the skin is worn; hidden leaves it out until it is shown from Arrange mode.

width.description: A preferred width in pixels, where the section has a width of its own.

height.description: A preferred height in pixels, the least the section takes.

template.description: application-chips is the APPLICATIONS chips; application-list is one line per application with its channel picker, for a narrow column; application-columns puts tiles of one width in columns of perColumn, top to bottom, the columns left to right, and a column that does not fit goes below, whole.

perColumn.description: How many applications one column holds before the next column starts. Only with template application-columns.

layoutPopOut.description: Where the submixer starts out under this skin. A default only: it applies while ui.json holds no docking choice of the user's, and then once per skin and layout version.

default.description: docked keeps the submixer in the main window; detached opens it in its own window once when the skin is put on.
